bound_or_value.quantity: maximum corrected load in complete lot Lark

satisfied_premises: The complete lot consists of P and Q, measured once on 2031-04-09 in glims.
Corrected load equals recorded load minus assigned profile bias, with no other corrections.
The accepted acquisition assignment maps P to amber and Q to blue.
Exact matching calibration supplies amber bias 2 and blue bias 8.
P has corrected load 11−2=9 glims; Q has corrected load 17−8=9 glims.
Every corrected load is at most 12 glims.
rationale: The acquisition and calibration records match Lark, 2031-04-09, and glims. The accepted acquisition assignment supplies the piece-to-profile mapping; calibration supplies the corresponding exact biases. Both pieces have corrected loads of 9 glims, so acceptance holds for the complete lot in every state compatible with the accepted evidence.
